messages:
Maya: Quick design check — compact chart row in the dashboard. Two issues: 1) legend items wrap when the sidebar collapses, 2) tall outliers get visually clipped in the sparkline preview and read like a flat line. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/ux/mini-chart-clip.png

Derek: Agree on clipping — the mini sparklines give false negatives when spikes are truncated. Could we autoscale the preview independently of the full chart?

Lena: Autoscaling improves visibility but hurts cross-row trend comparison. Alternative: keep global scale but show a subtle spike indicator (thin vertical line) when the true peak is outside preview bounds. Hover shows the actual peak value/time.

Sam (Design): +1 on the spike indicator. Also dislike multi-line legend wraps in compact rows — they push the sparkline down. Two options: (A) single-line truncated legend with ellipsis + hover expand, (B) hide less-critical metadata (units) behind an icon reveal.

Theo (Eng): (A) is trivial: CSS text-overflow + title tooltip. (B) requires extra interactive affordances and keyboard targets. Prototype (A) first.

Maya: Ok (A) for a quick win. But tooltip must be accessible via keyboard and screen reader (not just title attr). Sam, can you draft hover/focus copy?

Sam (Design): Tooltip copy draft: "Series: request latency — peak 2.4s at 14:12 UTC — unit: p95 (ms)". For ellipsis state, screen reader text should announce full series name + hint "press Enter to reveal more details".

Derek: Outlier marker popup content suggestion (compact two lines):
Peak: 2.4s (200% of median)
Time: 14:12 UTC
Keyboard: focus + Enter opens same popup.

Maya: Accessibility nit — marker must have >= 3:1 contrast and be keyboard reachable without reordering focus.

Theo (Eng): Implementation plan: use an SVG overlay for the sparkline preview and add an extra <line> element for the marker. Add aria-labelledby linking to popup content. Performance should be fine for ~50 rows; batch DOM updates.

ui-bot: reminder: design review checklist added to PR #4227 — https://git.redwood/PR/4227

Lena: Copy nit: tiny rows make axis unit labels ambiguous. Suggest: show unit only in expanded modal; in compact rows use unit icon with tooltip.

Sam (Design): Decision proposal: ship legend truncation (A) + accessible tooltip, add outlier marker + keyboard popup, defer autoscaling to v2 after measuring confusion. I'll write the a11y spec + copy.

Maya: Action items: Sam — a11y spec & tooltip copy; Theo — prototype (SVG marker + aria) in branch; Derek — add popup content example to PR; Lena — validate copy in small-screen mock. Target: prototype by EOD Friday.

Theo (Eng): Starting the spike now, will ping with demo link.

Maya: Thanks team :thumbsup:
